paper_title: Rethinking Repetition Problems of LLMs in Code Generation
caption: The performance of RPG applied to LLMs of different sizes. This result is the average value across three scenarios on CodeRepetEval dataset.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The provided bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of two decoding strategies, Greedy and RPG, applied to two different-sized LLMs, CodeLlama-7B and CodeLlama-34B, across four distinct evaluation metrics: EGP ↑, TR-N ↓, TR-S ↓, and CCP ↑. The horizontal axis, labeled “Metrics,” displays these four categories in the order presented, with arrows indicating whether higher or lower values are desirable for each metric. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The chart employs a grouped bar format for each metric, with four bars per group representing the four different model-decoding combinations. The legend indicates that the blue bars correspond to Greedy decoding, the orange bars to RPG decoding, the green bars to Greedy decoding with CodeLlama-34B, and the brown bars to RPG decoding with CodeLlama-34B. Within each group, the bars are arranged from left to right as: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B). The chart does not visually emphasize any specific bars through shading, bolding, or additional annotations.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two decoding strategies—Greedy and RPG—applied to two different-sized LLMs (CodeLlama-7B and CodeLlama-34B) across four distinct metrics: EGP ↑, TR-N ↓, TR-S ↓, and CCP ↑. The horizontal axis, labeled “Metrics,” presents these four categories in left-to-right order, with arrows indicating whether higher or lower values are better for each metric. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each metric group contains four bars, color-coded according to the legend: blue for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), orange for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), green for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and brown for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). For EGP ↑, the performance values are approximately 0.0 for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), 0.9 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.6 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 1.0 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). For TR-N ↓, the values are approximately 0.7 for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), 0.45 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.6 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.4 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). For TR-S ↓, the values are approximately 0.7 for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), 0.4 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.45 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.3 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). For CCP ↑, the values are approximately 0.4 for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), 0.7 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.7 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.95 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the metrics. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and height.
